profile.birdiesExplanation: The average number of birdies (one under par) you score per round.
profile.parsExplanation: The average number of pars you make per round.
profile.bogeysExplanation: The average number of bogeys (one over par) per round.
profile.doublePlusExplanation: The average number of double bogeys or worse per round.
profile.par3Explanation: Your average score on Par 3 holes.
profile.par4Explanation: Your average score on Par 4 holes.
profile.par5Explanation: Your average score on Par 5 holes.
profile.bestToParExplanation: Your best score relative to par across all recorded rounds.
profile.blowUpHolesExplanation: The percentage of holes where you scored triple bogey or worse.
profile.consistencyExplanation: The percentage of your rounds that fall within 5 shots of your average score.
